_comment: beyond-ui skills catalog — the ONLY source of truth for which upstream skills exist and how they install. 5 PERMANENT (fixed, star-ranked top-5 design skills; always installed, always active) + POOL (routable units; exactly 5 are selected per project by scripts/skills-router.mjs against the project profile). Never install the whole catalog: that is the 33-skill waste this replaces. starCount is evidence from the GitHub API; `starsVerified` records when.

selection._comment: Deterministic rule: exactly 5 pool units are selected. Score = 2*|tags.surface ∩ profile.surface| + 2*|tags.stack ∩ profile.stack| + 3*|tags.concern ∩ profile.concern| + 1 if any tags match at all. Ties broken by higher starCount, then id (alphabetical). If fewer than 5 pool units match any tag, the highest-star remaining units fill the gap — the count is always exactly 5. `node scripts/skills-router.mjs verify` asserts the final totals: 5 permanent + 5 selected = 10, never 10 references and never 33 skills.

permanent.label: frontend-design (Anthropic)
permanent.use: DIRECTION and CRITIQUE: AI-tell calibration clusters, two-pass plan (token plan + ASCII wireframe before code), one orchestrated moment, 'spend your boldness in one place', the Chanel rule.
permanent.why: Highest-star design skill in existence (179k) and the origin of the anti-AI-slop discipline every other skill descends from.

permanent.label: ui-ux-pro-max (nextlevelbuilder)
permanent.use: SCOUT and DIRECTION: SELECT the style/palette/type-pairing/industry-pattern from its BM25-searchable database instead of inventing one; its 79 UI styles + 192 palettes + 74 font pairings + industry anti-pattern rules. Never freehand a palette when this database can answer it.
permanent.why: Second-highest-star skill (132k); the design-intelligence database that turns 'pick a style' into a lookup instead of a guess.

permanent.label: frontend-ui-engineering (Addy Osmani)
permanent.use: BUILD and VERIFY: spacing-scale discipline (never invent a 13px), semantic tokens, real <button>/<input>, focus management in dialogs, skeletons over spinners, WCAG 2.1 AA floor, 320/768/1024/1440 testing, composition over configuration.
permanent.why: 100k-star engineering craft layer — the part that keeps the beauty from breaking at runtime.

permanent.label: taste-skill (leonxlnx)
permanent.use: RECON and CRITIQUE: write the one-line Design Read before code; anti-default discipline; one accent; palette rotation; layout-family repetition ban; max 1 eyebrow per 3 sections; never h-screen (min-h-[100dvh]); no placeholder-as-label; one CTA intent per label.
permanent.why: 91k-star prescriptive taste rules with concrete dials — the closest thing to a senior designer looking over your shoulder.

permanent.label: impeccable (pbakaus)
permanent.use: CRITIQUE and POLISH: tinted neutrals (never pure grey), no grey text on colour, no card-in-card, no bounce/elastic easing, live in-browser iteration on the RENDERED page (not in imagination), its 61 deterministic detector rules.
permanent.why: 73k-star polish layer with deterministic detectors — iteration happens on the rendered page, which is exactly where AI claims usually evaporate.

pool.label: hallmark (Nutlope)
pool.use: CRITIQUE: the 57-gate slop test, six-axis pre-emit self-critique stamp, structural variety across outputs (never colour swaps), honest copy (never invent a metric), locked tokens, no fake browser/phone chrome, headers roman.

pool.label: web-design-guidelines (Vercel)
pool.use: BUILD and VERIFY: the 100+ rule Web Interface Guidelines — never outline:none without focus-visible, never transition:all, honour prefers-reduced-motion, animate transform/opacity only, never block paste, submit stays enabled, URL reflects state, tabular-nums, text-wrap:balance, explicit image dimensions, no div onClick.

pool.label: react-best-practices (Vercel)
pool.use: BUILD (React only): kill waterfalls with Promise.all, bundle discipline (no barrel imports, next/dynamic), server-side auth in server actions, React.cache, re-render and JS micro-optimisation.

pool.label: composition-patterns (Vercel)
pool.use: BUILD (React only): compound components over boolean-prop soup, decouple state from implementation, explicit variants over modes, children over render props, React 19 drops forwardRef.

pool.label: react-view-transitions (Vercel)
pool.use: MOTION (React only): View Transition API done properly — shared element > Suspense reveal > list identity > state change; every transition must communicate continuity.

pool.label: react-native-skills (Vercel)
pool.use: BUILD (React Native only): FlashList for long lists, animate only transform/opacity on the UI thread (Reanimated), native stack/tabs, expo-image, Pressable over TouchableOpacity, safe areas.

pool.label: accesslint a11y suite (AccessLint)
pool.starNote: renamed repo (API returned Moved Permanently 2026-10-01) — treat as unstarred specialist tool, not a popularity claim
pool.use: A11Y (specialist): audit the RENDERED DOM with @accesslint/core — locate, inspect (keyboard, names/roles/states, reflow, zoom, reduced motion), audit (WCAG-EM sampling), fix, diff. Findings carry an evidence basis (verified / confirm-with-human / human-required).

pool.label: refactoring-ui port (gnurio)
pool.use: DIRECTION and POLISH: the Refactoring-UI principles in composition order — hierarchy → spacing → type scale → palette → button hierarchy → clutter removal → shadows → empty states → contrast → proximity.

pool.label: bencium design triad (controlled/innovative/impact)
pool.use: DIRECTION: commit to ONE of three designer philosophies — controlled (enterprise, WCAG-first), innovative (campaign/concept), impact (production anti-slop) — with its explicit NEVER list (Inter/Roboto/Space Grotesk as default, generic SaaS blue, purple gradients, glassmorphism, Apple mimicry, blob backgrounds).

toolSkills.label: skill-creator (Anthropic)
toolSkills.use: Authoring the condensed project skill (.beyond-ui/SKILL.md). Tooling, not design taste — installed with the tool layer and NOT counted in the 10.

toolSkills.label: playwright-skill (lackeyjb)
toolSkills.use: Browser capture/interaction for teardown and QA. Tooling — NOT counted in the 10.

toolSkills.label: scrapling skill (Scrapling-Plugin)
toolSkills.use: Keyless acquisition (scrape/map/deep) for the scout and teardown content layer. Tooling — NOT counted in the 10.

toolSkills.label: browser-use skill (browser-use)
toolSkills.use: Human-like browser QA (surf the built app like a person: click, type, scroll, judge). Tooling — NOT counted in the 10.
